Question: I have seen myself in Masjid e navabi and was near to the Roza of our prophet PBUH. i went near to the gate(near to the jaali from where you can see the real khabar)i looked into from it.I felt that prophet PBUH resting on his right hand side.As we are recommened to sleep during night(Sunnah of prophet) what does this dream mean and this happended juist before i wake up for the fajr prayers. Answer ID: 22374 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 837/662/D=1431) Ma-sha-Allah the dream is very nice. You should pay special attention towards following sunnah and sharia, and avoid nonsense and evil deeds. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
